lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap volunteered geographic information for Pakistan. The dataset includes approximately 749.1 thousand buildings mapped by OSM contributors, with data quality assessed through temporal metadata (average age 3 years, 8% updated in last 6 months). Geometry is provided in multiple standard formats (SHP, GeoJSON, GeoPackage, KML) for interoperability.
